Last summer we cleaned out the camera roll on my phone before a long trip, and it took most of a weekend. There were thousands of screenshots of chats, boarding passes, parking receipts and recipes that nobody would ever look at again, plus long bursts of almost identical photos from a birthday party, a few dozen pictures that were completely black because the phone had been in a pocket, and blurry shots of the dog running across the beach at sunset. We wanted to keep the good family photos and the landscapes from the mountain hike, but delete everything else, and we wished the phone could understand each picture.
